; ghostbuster-automated.qmd - full screen refresh on its own, at the moments
; where ghosting is left behind. Each event restarts a short timer, so the
; refresh happens once, after the screen has finished drawing. Every trigger
; writes "gba: <event>" to the xochitl journal, to see which one fired.
; Events:
;   settings opened                    (Settings.qml, onOpened)
;   document stopped loading, but only if the loading indicator was shown
;                                      (DocumentView.qml: loadingIndicator, isBusy, isLoading)
;   library got input focus back for the first time after waking up or after
;   xochitl start, that is after the PIN screen (Navigator.qml: BatteryManager,
;   activeFocus)
; Source: ghostbuster-automated.qmd.in, encoded by Tools\Remarkable\encode-qmd.py.
; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only. Built for firmware 3.29.1.

; Settings opened
AFFECT [[12599552112012170435]]
    IMPORT [[197082280.8400022150001312063]] 1.0
    TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: gbaSettingsTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 400
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&233724020023100&~.~&197092075&~("gba: settings opened");
                    ~&6687579895491175043&~.clearGhosting();
                }
            }
        }

        REBUILD [[7713401573498017]]
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM \~&482865290967253827&~.~&8400213107195236010&~(~&433854763438791459&~.~&14038221081077499285&~);\ INSERT STREAM \ gbaSettingsTimer.~&233743006639214&~();\
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: gbaLoadingTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 1000
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.~&7082784038440&~ || ~&6504254477&~.~&254534022647302435&~) {
                        ~&7083121450889&~;
                    }
                    ~&6504254477&~.gbaIndicatorShown = ~&214625660372&~;
                    ~&233724020023100&~.~&197092075&~("gba: document loaded, " + ~&6504254477&~.gbaLoadingReason);
                    ~&6687579895491175043&~.clearGhosting();
                }
            }

            ~&428051690305612204&~ {
                ~&7083194890448&~: ~&12173585954242770596&~
                function ~&13733777459642361598&~() {
                    ~&5972376&~ (~&12173585954242770596&~.~&233748328658231&~) {

            ~&428051690305612204&~ {

                function onIsBusyChanged() {
